argv:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science
OUT="$ROOT/.one-wave-metadata"
mkdir -p "$OUT/cern" "$OUT/gwosc"

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, urllib.parse, urllib.request, datetime

root = pathlib.Path("/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science/.one-wave-metadata")
(root/"cern").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root/"gwosc").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def get_json(url):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":"One-Wave-Metadata/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        return json.load(r)

cern_url = "https://opendata.cern.ch/api/records/?q=" + urllib.parse.quote("type:Dataset") + "&size=1"
gwosc_url = "https://gwosc.org/api/v2/runs"

cern = get_json(cern_url)
gwosc = get_json(gwosc_url)

(root/"cern"/"dataset_sample.json").write_text(json.dumps(cern, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
(root/"gwosc"/"runs.json").write_text(json.dumps(gwosc, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

index = {
    "retrieved_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "sources": {
        "cern": {
            "url": cern_url,
            "file": "cern/dataset_sample.json",
            "top_level_keys": sorted(cern.keys()) if isinstance(cern, dict) else []
        },
        "gwosc": {
            "url": gwosc_url,
            "file": "gwosc/runs.json",
            "top_level_keys": sorted(gwosc.keys()) if isinstance(gwosc, dict) else []
        }
    }
}
(root/"index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

print("METADATA_INGEST_OK")
print(json.dumps(index, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
PY

printf '\nFILES\n'
find "$OUT" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' | sort
intention: Query official CERN Open Data and GWOSC public metadata endpoints, persist a bounded local metadata cache, and build a source index proving the metadata path works.
consequence: Create only a small local .one-wave-metadata cache under the authorized repository checkout; do not download strain datasets, CERN bulk files, modify tracked science files, or change credentials.
